description:
Honey bees are not just honey makers — they are master communicators and rulers of one of nature’s most organized societies.
In this video, we explore the fascinating world of the honey bee and uncover:
🐝 How worker bees use the famous waggle dance to communicate the exact location of food
🐝 How vibrations, pheromones, and touch help maintain colony order
🐝 The dramatic mating flight of the queen bee
🐝 Why a queen mates only once in her lifetime
🐝 The role of drones and what happens after mating
